full_prompt_en: A square street-art photograph shows a large stag leaping across an exterior concrete wall. Its body stretches from center-left toward the right, with front legs reaching forward and hind legs kicked back. An expansive branching antler rises above its head and spreads into delicate, tree-like lines. The animal is not a solid painted silhouette. Countless thin dark strokes, loops, and flecks are layered into a wiry body that looks both substantial and partly transparent. Loose marks trail behind its legs and along the right edge, giving the leap a sense of speed and dispersal. The stag occupies the middle of a broad pale gray wall, whose vertical construction seams and weathered streaks remain visible through and around the artwork. Above the concrete, a strip of reddish brick and dark projecting structure crosses the top edge. A strong diagonal wedge of shadow falls across the upper right of the wall, while the lower left remains in open daylight. The real sidewalk and curb form a low horizontal band at the bottom, anchoring the mural in a quiet urban location. There are no nearby people to distract from the scale of the animal. Natural daylight makes the rough concrete readable and lets the dark linework stand sharply against it. The wall's muted neutral color keeps the stag as the single dominant form. The camera looks straight toward the surface from across the street, preserving its full leap and the surrounding architectural frame. The result combines the energy of an animal in motion with the patient accumulation of fine graphic marks, as if the form might unravel into the air around it.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术照片描绘一头巨鹿跃过外部混凝土墙。身体从中央偏左伸向右侧，前腿向前探，后腿向后蹬。宽阔的分叉鹿角从头上升起，扩散成细密的树枝状线条。动物不是实心彩绘剪影。无数细小深色笔线、环线和碎点层叠为丝网般身体，看似有重量，又局部透明。松散痕迹从腿后和右边缘散出，赋予跳跃速度与消散感。鹿占据宽阔浅灰墙面中部，混凝土的竖向施工缝和风化水痕穿过并围绕画作可见。混凝土上方，一条红褐砖墙和深色外挑结构横过上边缘。一块强烈斜向阴影落在墙面右上方，左下方则处于开阔日光中。真实人行道和路缘在底部形成低低的横带，将壁画安置在安静城市地点。周围没有人分散动物尺度的注意力。自然日光让粗糙混凝土可读，也使深色线条在其前锐利突出。墙面低饱和中性色让鹿成为唯一主导形体。相机从街对面正对墙面，完整保留它的飞跃和周围建筑框架。结果把运动中动物的能量与细致图形笔痕的耐心积累结合起来，仿佛形体随时会散入周围空气。
style_prompt_en: Street-art photography presents a large form built from hundreds of fine, dark, directional strands rather than solid fill. Layered loops, scratches, and flecks make the shape dense at its core and airy at the edges, with stray marks implying movement. A weathered neutral wall remains visible as a textured ground, including seams, stains, and real cast shadow. Natural daylight and a frontal camera keep the mural legible and preserve its relationship to pavement and architecture. The contrast is simple and graphic, yet the mark-making is intricate and restless.
style_prompt_zh: 街头艺术摄影呈现由数百条细暗方向线构成、而非实心填色的大型形体。层叠环线、刮线和碎点让中心浓密、边缘透气，游离痕迹暗示运动。风化中性墙面作为有质地的底保持可见，包括接缝、污迹和真实投影。自然日光与正面相机让壁画清晰，保留它与路面和建筑的关系。反差简单而图形化，笔痕却复杂且躁动。
theme_en: A leaping stag made of dark wiry strokes across a concrete wall
theme_zh: 深色丝线状笔痕构成的跃鹿跨过混凝土墙
name: DALeast
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
